aggregate_initial_judgment: Read before opening seat totals. Claim: a frozen VLM high-level planner reasons over an online Hydra scene graph, CLIP-selected key views, history and a topological floorplan, choosing explore_room / go_to_objects / find_room; deterministic low-level planners score frontiers/viewpoints, with find_room weighting frontiers by floorplan graph distance. Evidence: 108 OpenEQA + 114 ExploreEQA single-floor HM3D episodes (filtered so floorplans can be generated from HM3D semantic annotations), five VLMs, same 50-iteration budget, GraphEQA/ExploreEQA rerun; Gemini-only leave-one-out ablations (FP, VP, SF), GraphEQA+FP, GT-semantics analysis; no-choice answers graded by an unvalidated LLM; 7 'representative' real-world questions run once. Concerns: the simulation floorplan is derived from ground-truth annotations although the method claims robustness to weak priors; without FP, HFLEX is below GraphEQA and GraphEQA+FP on ExploreEQA; no question-only (blind) baseline. Expected: online, scoped, E.causality ~2-3, E.statistics 1.

paper.title: Hierarchical Floorplan-Guided Vision-Language Exploration for Embodied Question Answering
paper.central_claim: HFLEX-EQA combines hierarchical VLM planning, online scene graphs, specialized exploration modes and weak topological floorplan priors to outperform existing EQA baselines on OpenEQA/ExploreEQA and deploy successfully in previously unseen real indoor environments.

signatures.information: Frozen VLM sees online hierarchical graph, selected RGB memory, history, question/optional choices, and prior semantic room connectivity; RGB-D/poses/TSDF remain in low-level geometry
signatures.operation: VLM emits one of explore_room/go_to_objects/find_room with structured target; deterministic semantic/geometric planners choose reachable frontiers or sampled visibility-maximizing views; collect new observation and repeat
signatures.output: Navigation target and updated graph/visual evidence; final answer when self-confidence >=0.8
signatures.conditions: Pose/depth/segmentation adequate, graph binds objects/rooms, VLM confidence meaningful, low-level reachable-space planner reliable
signatures.feedback: Fresh images and incremental scene graph returned after low-level motion; no external answer correctness feedback at runtime
signatures.selection_rule: CLIP relevance for within-room frontiers, depth-occlusion/image coverage for object views; self-confidence terminates answer construction
signatures.selection_data: Current episode only; benchmark correctness not runtime feedback
signatures.persistence: Within-episode graph/key views/decision history; static algorithm and frozen models
signatures.later_use: Later decisions of same episode; no across-task learned edit or retained capability claim
signatures.claimed_effect: Gather missing rather than redundant evidence for EQA
signatures.failure_boundary: Graph errors and uncalibrated answer confidence propagate; illumination/view angle not in geometric view score

signatures.object: Prior-guided discovery of unobserved room classes
signatures.information: Floorplan labels/connectivity from simulator annotations or human layout; no metric coordinates or localization; online semantic label constrained to prior classes
signatures.operation: Match all same-class floorplan nodes, compute neighboring-class shortest-distance softmax toward target class, mix weighted CLIP frontier scores with transition semantics and frontier size
signatures.output: Highest-scored frontier; zero prior weight if class/path unavailable
signatures.conditions: Prior labels/connectivity sufficiently informative and room/frontier CLIP features trustworthy
signatures.feedback: Observed rooms update graph/class matching; static prior is not corrected or optimized
signatures.selection_rule: Fixed weights .35 transition/.55 floorplan/.1 size; no learned selection
signatures.selection_data: Current graph/prior; no retained selection protocol
signatures.persistence: Fixed prior for episode and online map, not a self-improving memory
signatures.claimed_effect: Choose useful unseen-room direction without exact floorplan localization
signatures.failure_boundary: Wrong but connected priors can mislead; no perturbation suite for floorplans, missing classes constrain room labels
